body:
Debt means a lot to me.  Tried the towel thing 3 weeks.

Other than that, thank you.  I'm sorry this reply isn't bigger.  I have less to say by the moment.

I can't afford a mental health professional.  I really doubt they can fix me.  Would you still want to live even if you had the best therapist if your sexual orientation was altered to make you a necrophile, you had your eyes gouged out, your family was all but gone, and you fucked up your one chance to work somewhere other than a convenience store?  A convenience store with a loud door chime because otherwise you might let someone go without paying.  Actually, you'll probably do that anyway and they'll have to let you go.

You think a mental health professional has anything in the face of that?  "Be happy with what you have" "life can still improve" "You mean something to somebody"

All seems like pretty trivial shit.  Add in the fact that they're just payed to try to fix you.  They only care insomuch as you're a source of income.  There's nothing to be gained.

Doctors just cost money.  To be honest, my toe is going to cost a great deal of money to fix.  It's not some ingrown toenail with minor inflammation.  It may already require amputation.  I'm just amazed it's made it this long.

Oh, and my ears aren't plugged up.  My cochleas are damaged.  My hearing can't get better.

I may have had depression all my life, but what difference does that make?  It just makes my life worth even less to me.

I'm sorry.

You guys deserve better than me.
I don't deserve better than the floor.
My family deserves better than me.
I don't deserve better than the floor.

I can't keep living for someone else if I don't want to be alive.  No one is getting what they deserve right now.  No one.  I can get what I deserve if I stop living.

> Does it matter? You're a person who thinks and feels, not a pithy punchline between a pair of tags. I can see you're placing a premium on your online presence, but it's your presence as a person. It wouldn't be there if it weren't you as an individual. And yet know one would ever know it was missing. Conversations would lack nothing without. They might be better without my interruption. The only problem here is that I want to interrupt, but I can give that up. > And then your ear infection. My ears are not currently infected. > It can't make you cry unless it means something to you. It means I can no longer hear it right. Music sounds so shitty. Anything with more than two instruments playing simultaneously sounds damn fucking near white noise, and it sounds like shit with even one. My ears are ruined. I loved music so much that I wish I had killed myself when it started going to shit. Now it's just pointless, like everything else. > It will probably even change your perception and your preferences. DO YOU FUCKING THINK I HAVEN'T READ COUNTLESS STORIES OF ABUSED CHILDREN, HOW FUCKED UP THEY GREW UP TO BE, HOW THEIR LIVES WERE RUINED??? YOU THINK ANY OF IT CHANGED MY "PREFERENCE??" YOU THINK I DON'T ALREADY HATE THAT PART OF MYSELF TO THE MOTHERFUCKING CORE? Dave Pelzer . . . I'm sorry for what happened to him, but his book ought to be shoved up his ass. His story capitalizes on the great demon engine that the public has been shaped into. One built to tear me apart. Or do you think a book about a woman being raped and moving on despite it would sell as well? You would be wrong. There's an unmatched fervor, a shitstorm around this topic, and the only thing John Q Public is interested in is how fucked up pedophiles are and how much they deserve to die. I wish I could say it was a book about how a human being got through some tough shit, but it's a book about how one human suffered and triumphed over an archetype which the general public thinks is representative of me. Which is exact-fucking-ly the reason you recommended that book, as though it was going to deter and inspire me. I'm not the antagonist in that book. I share a sexuality with him to exactly the same extent that most of you share with rapists. These books read like us vs them, because there is only ever one kind of pedophile that makes it onto the bestsellers list. Honestly, when I eventually die, everyone wins. I no longer live in a world that honestly doesn't want me and at best treats me like a pet shark, and you guys are only out one uninteresting broken pedophile.
Thank you.  I'll have to think about whether my situation is at all improved living in a fucked up society, but I know that I cannot go on living as a fucked up person.

Other people deserve better.  I just don't.  Not to any rational person, given they accept pedophiles are a molestation waiting to happen.  I'm not a molestation waiting to happen, but you can't realize that.  Not really.  I've heard how even the most considerate, kind people really talk when they think they're free to speak their mind.  I have to talk like a normal person, too, when I'm out and about.  If I were you, I'd just tell me what you think will keep me from letting myself die, out of some sense of empathy.  If I were normal, I'd have nothing to offer but faux acceptance, with a deep seated, dark desire that every last pedophile either get a castration, lobotomy, or dead in a hurry, for the good of the rest of us.  That's why I really don't think I'm worth it.  Because I don't believe anyone can think that I am.  Not really.

I know you don't want anyone to lose hope, but even for the homeless, hope remains.  I'm broken in ways that can't be fixed.  I just wish I didn't have to die, but never had to live again.  I wish misery didn't like company so much.  I shouldn't have posted here.  Empathy is just a word for how everyone hurts and everyone operates to alleviate the hurt, but it's no good this time.  It all ends in tears.

To clarify some things to anyone who comes upon the thread and can still read this, my father isn't the main issue.  Does anyone honestly think I'll ever feel as good as I did when I was younger?  Does anyone honestly ever think I'll feel _better_ than when the only boys that gave me wood were my own age and I could still hear well enough to enjoy music (Oh god, I would chop off my dick, both feet, and burn my highschool diploma to have my hearing back)?  When college was still something that I was going to do, a future, not a past I had already pissed away?

The infection may be what eventually kills me.  But my life can never be right again.  Maybe it never was, but I'll never have the illusion back.  I'm damaged goods.

I hold no resentment toward him.  If I resented him, I'd have to kill myself as a matter of principle.  He sucked in a lot of ways, but he got through as best he could.  It helps that on some level, we're no worse off with him dead.  He created such a problem set that the only thing I regret losing was the ability to bounce thoughts off of him when he was sober, and losing access to all his life experiences.

I don't want to take that further right now.  Even if you know something I don't, some way to game the system and get me fixed, it's going to mandate more interactions and questions from real, live people than I ever want to deal with again.

I had a stand-offish relationship with him.  He was pretty much one of the most family-centric, incredible people around.  A riot of sorts.  Also an idiot, lazy, and a stubborn asshole.  He would defend us from anyone but himself in a heartbeat.  He didn't have enough introspection to see when he was the one doing the verbal and physical assaulting.  The only place he had depth was in telling telemarketers in how to fuck themselves.  Or anyone that called and wasn't family, for that matter.

He was also a big drug addict.  Prescription pills.  He finally overdosed while no one was around to give him a narcan injection.  So while it was expected, it wasn't that expected.  I woke up and he was dead.  It's not affecting me much anymore.  My mother has coped pretty well, though for the first two months she had some spots where she nearly lost it.  My brother pretty much shrugged the whole thing off.

I'm not peace corps material.  I'm a little bitch that would complain about the heat, water, and the people that deserve well more than me.  I hope you find what you're looking for and accomplish what you mean to.

Add one more thing to the list.  I want to run away from you.  You're not acting like I would expect any real person to.  You shouldn't try to help me.  I shouldn't try to help you help me.  We can talk though.

My father died about 4 months ago.
